reviewMethod: Assistant source review of the five stored baseline outputs against the already human-confirmed meanings. No additional provider or model judge calls. Quality is assessed separately in statements/response and downstream instruction.
limits: No actual plan or calendar reference was supplied.
A clarification about the selected week is therefore not automatically an error.
Not explicitly represented does not prove an actual direction change.
No finished plan or actual user-facing output was generated by either experiment.
